reply.emotion: energetic and purposeful, getting straight to work
notes: Use putzen when talking about cleaning a room, a surface, or your teeth (Zähne putzen).
Do not confuse with saubermachen, which is a more colloquial, general way to say tidy up.

senses.definition: To remove dirt from something to make it clean.

examples.text: Ich muss heute das Badezimmer putzen.
examples.translation: I have to clean the bathroom today.
examples.emotion: reluctant and sighing about household chores

senses.definition: To clean part of your body, especially your teeth.

examples.text: Vergiss nicht, dir die Zähne zu putzen.
examples.translation: Don't forget to brush your teeth.
examples.emotion: caring and reminding someone gently before bed

definitions: To remove dirt from something to make it clean.
To clean part of your body, especially your teeth.
